phase_erasure.generic_constraint_call: monomorphized to sealed direct or sealed invoke before XrProgram
phase_erasure.source_import_call: whole-program link resolves the imported declaration to one canonical FunctionId before XrProgram
phase_erasure.interface_conformance_check: verified compile-time fact; runtime operation exists only when an existential value is formed
phase_erasure.devirtualized_existential_call: optimization of a witness call, guarded by translation validation; canonical semantics remain witness dispatch

canonical_entities.callable_signature: ordered READ/REF/MOVE parameters, result ownership, typed error/panic channels, effects and borrowed-result origins
canonical_entities.callable_value: typed value containing one closed callable target identity and an optional typed capture aggregate
canonical_entities.interface_declaration: stable nominal interface identity plus ordered object-safe witness slots
canonical_entities.conformance: stable nominal implementor identity and kind plus an exact slot-to-function map
canonical_entities.existential_value: typed carrier intent containing one concrete value and one exact conformance identity
canonical_entities.witness_call: dispatch through one verified interface slot; selector, method name and body shape are not operands
canonical_entities.borrowed_result: sorted deduplicated PARAM, RECEIVER and STATIC origin rows owned by the callable signature

operation_atoms.law: call one typed callable value whose signature has no error or panic channel
call one typed callable value and transfer to normal, optional typed-error and optional typed-panic continuations
dispatch one existential receiver through one exact object-safe witness slot with no error or panic channel
dispatch one existential receiver through one exact object-safe witness slot and explicit typed continuations
form one existential value from a concrete value and exact conformance identity
test an existential value against one exact nominal implementor identity
project the concrete value after a dominating successful exact nominal test
form one typed callable value from a closed target identity and optional capture aggregate

explicit_non_operations.source_import: whole-program symbol resolution and identity remap
explicit_non_operations.interface_upcast: existential.pack with a different verified conformance/view identity
explicit_non_operations.devirtualized_call: private VM/AOT optimization of a witness call
explicit_non_operations.selector_or_name_lookup: forbidden; dispatch uses stable interface and slot identity
explicit_non_operations.class_only_itable: forbidden as canonical semantics; carrier lowering is nominal-kind-neutral
explicit_non_operations.borrow_lifetime: signature-owned origin rows and Wave 3 call-bound loan facts
explicit_non_operations.dynamic_unknown_call: forbidden; an unknown target set or signature fails before XrProgram

borrow_origin_contract.source_syntax: returning direct const Slice<T> declares 'from' PARAM, RECEIVER or STATIC origins
borrow_origin_contract.type_identity: sorted and deduplicated (kind, parameter ordinal) set; names, source order, duplicates and elision are excluded
borrow_origin_contract.body_role: verify every actual return root belongs to the signature set; never infer signature authority
borrow_origin_contract.call_mapping: map every formal origin to caller RootIds, recursively expand view actuals, then sort and deduplicate
borrow_origin_contract.xi_evidence: retain only a normalized source recipe; consumers recursively materialize the complete caller-local root set from current SSA operands, with no mutable root cache, and the verifier rejects empty, cyclic or invalid recipes
borrow_origin_contract.semantic_plan_boundary: legacy scalar SemanticPlan projection fails XR_SEM_0019 for every non-singleton set until program tables land
borrow_origin_contract.compatibility: no scalar origin fields, body-derived fallback, old reader or dual path

old_owner_inventory.owner: body-derived receiver permission and borrowed-return source
old_owner_inventory.canonical_replacement: declaration-owned receiver mode and normalized BorrowOriginSet
sealed FunctionId, typed callable signature or interface witness slot

backend selector, method-name and implementor body inspection
old_owner_inventory.canonical_replacement: validated conformance slot map and private mechanical lowering

old_owner_inventory.canonical_replacement: whole-program link identity plus exact callable signature
